presets.name: Replace Desert Pyramid
presets.description: Replace the vanilla desert pyramid with Moog's desert temple. The desert temple's wall chests use the vanilla desert pyramid loot so mod loot injections still show up.

presets.name: Replace Jungle Temple
presets.description: Replace the vanilla jungle temple with Moog's jungle temple. The main chests use the vanilla jungle temple loot so mod loot injections still show up.

presets.name: Replace Ocean Monument
presets.description: Replace the vanilla ocean monument with Moog's ocean temple. Ocean explorer maps lead to the ocean temple.

presets.name: Replace Stronghold
presets.description: Replace the vanilla stronghold with Moog's stronghold. Eyes of ender lead to it, and its corridor chests use the vanilla stronghold loot so mod loot injections still show up.
